turns.text: Who's out of line on price within their segment, and what are our top 5 products by margin?

csvChecks.ask: outliers.csv with columns customer_id,index_pct,reference_pct,gap_gbp: every customer whose price index is at least 10 points from its segment reference, with its index and reference in % and the gap in GBP (negative below the reference)
top_products.csv with columns sku,gm_pct: the top 5 products by margin, in %, and any product tied with the fifth
